o.text: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish لیمان, ultimately from Medieval Greek λιμένιον (liménion), from Ancient Greek λιμήν (limḗn).
Borrowed from Armenian գութան (gutʻan) or Georgian გუთანი (gutani).
From Arabic آبِدة (ʔābida). See also Turkish abide.
Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *eŋse. Cognate with Turkish ense, Chuvash ӗнсе (ĕns̬e), etc.
